title: Marcos believes China wants South China Sea COC too
summary: Marcos believes China wants South China Sea COC too

blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China —President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. on Friday said that he "felt strongly" that China also wants the Code of Conduct (COC) on the South China Sea be finalized soon, just like all member-states of the ASEAN.
In a Kapihan with the media, Marcos said he is “highly encouraged by the attitude” that China showcases with regard to the COC negotiations.
“Everyone is supportive of it, everyone is enthusiastic of it. For that matter, all sides…all the ASEAN leadership would like a COC,” Marcos said.
“And I think, I feel it very strongly that China would also like to have a COC. And they say so,” he added.
EXPLAINER: What is the South China Sea Code of Conduct?
Marcos said it is now up to Singapore, the next chair of ASEAN, to facilitate the anticipated finalization of the COC.
“The ball of course is now in Singapore's court. But everyone, all the shareholders in this matter have recognized the progress that we made during ASEAN in the Philippines,” he said.
The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) earlier said that Southeast Asian nations and China have completed negotiations on 80% of the COC.
Timeline: Rift deepens between PH, China over South China Sea
The South China Sea, or the West Philippine Sea for areas within Manila's 200-km exclusive economic zone, has been a point of contention between Beijing and Manila for years. —VAL, GMA News
